notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! It’s been a few months since our last update, but we’re still here, hard at work to make Dice of Arcana the best game it can be. We’ve made a lot of progress lately and couldn’t wait to share it with you — so we’ve just released a [b]major demo update[/b]! [/p][p]The new demo includes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved graphics and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Greater variety of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]More detailed and visually enhanced outdoor areas[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]New tag system[/p][/*][*][p]Better manual and clearer descriptions for dice and miniatures[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked shop layout[/p][/*][*][p]New turn system[/p][/*][*][p]New tile placement mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Added passive abilities (rings)[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled damage and attack system for miniatures[/p][/*][*][p]Attack trajectory visualization[/p][/*][*][p]New miniatures[/p][/*][*][p]New dice[/p][/*][*][p]New downtimes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game balance[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/ab53c5fe945f127c29c8671b3f56385a8b54cc8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear what you think — your feedback is incredibly valuable to us as we continue shaping the game.[/p][p]Try the new demo, join our [url="https://discord.gg/2Bz8M76tNp"]Discord[/url] community to share your thoughts, and if you’re enjoying the journey so far, don’t forget to wishlist Dice of Arcana on Steam — it really helps us out! Thanks for your support, and have fun on the road with the caravan![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest – Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/f3f6488af3776aa173e96fa734f86705282e1736.png[/img]

Just in time for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] we updated our demo with new content and mechanics!

[list]
[*] [b]Brand new roll system [/b]that lets you roll multiple dice at once. This allows interesting future upgrades to the game and reduces the randomess of the dice results.
[*] [b]6 extra dice[/b]
[*] 4 new opponents
[*] [b]Improved Guidebook [/b]readability
[*] Quick access to guidebook pages by inspecting dice and miniatures you own
[*] Increased the amount of items the shops will sell and improved the selection of items they offer
[*] Quite a few bug fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/c13484bc801a03de4090ee10b523f3ab0be2bd27.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy this new version of the demo!
 
Let us know what you think and help us improve [b]Dice of Arcana[/b]. You can either [url=https://discord.gg/2Bz8M76tNp]Join our Discord[/url] or use this [url=https://forms.gle/JexzXNdduvnpw3MW9]Google Form[/url].

notes.title: Devlog - July Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/0feb4cdd44aec9e8f3d5327480c335a76ef15b45.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the first of many dev updates after the announcement of Dice of Arcana earlier this month!
We always wanted to create a small horror title, but we needed to find the right idea, at the right time, to finally do it. Dice Of Arcana is a mix of things we think work very well together. Board/Dice games, with some deck building mechanics in it, and a dreamy/nightmerish theme, where real and surreal mix up, and anxiety kicks in.

The trailer tells a lot about how the game was one month ago. But what has happened since then?

[h2]New Miniatures Mechanic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/5c7de51e87056da3901ec1f6737b3d5a34823a7e.jpg[/img]

We decided to add extra depth using miniatures as the "focus" of the dice game. We felt that there was a need to deliver a more physical sense of the battle, hence the miniatures that have to be assigned to your dice pool to unleash some effects. 
This is also leveraging some combinatory mechanics. Miniatures will behave differently or have different effects depending on dice results, dice material and also... the plane of existence you are in. 

[h2]Astral Planes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/8e9258515286ff48b5be07a8a881c9e1bce1b3b3.jpg[/img]
This game is a trip down a horrific rabbit hole. The caravan is not enough. Game bosses will drag you to their Astral Plane, where their full power can be unleashed. 
New plane, new rules, and you'll have to understand them and try to use them to your advantage. 

[h2]New caravan design[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087015/a7a059b0d6fb29776a49a65a735b0d2d3c599f19.jpg[/img]
We decided to iterate a bit more on the caravan design. Even if we liked the previous one, it was too dark and empty, and we wanted it to look more real and full of interesting spots to look on for... well... it's not only dice, you all have to know!

Stay tuned for the next update!
